name: Enemy Posture System PRIVATE TEST
author: Dusklight community mods
description: PRIVATE TEST. Enemy Posture System 0.8.0. Below posture 100 a confirmed non-lethal hit never staggers a Bokoblin. NEW: a Shield Attack started just before a Bokoblin's melee blow lands is a PARRY when the game itself blocks that blow with Link's shield in the first frames of the Shield Attack: the attacker gains +40 posture, no HP loss and no Shield Attack stun; its blow ends as a native rejected swing. A parry that reaches 100 triggers the normal posture break. The hit that reaches 100 breaks the posture: native shield stun, then a short window where a decisive sword/Helm contact deals x1.50 once and knocks it down natively; Finish is available on the ground; after the get-up the posture rearms to 0. A thin posture bar under the enemy's life bar shows it (display only). Black Bokoblins in fury are not parried (Expansion shield chip). Replaces 0.7.0 and older versions of this mod (same ID): never load them together. Human Windows DX12 validation pending.
